data.narrative:
Electric Air is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Chris Mui and Jeremy Osbourne that has raised $500K to date. The Climate & Energy sector comp universe includes 9 private peers (Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen among them) and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though none provide sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage data for reliable peer-median benchmarking.

Given data scarcity, the Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable approach. Using the $500K total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier yields an implied valuation of $1.25M. This method assumes Electric Air's capital efficiency and market conditions align with sector norms for early-stage advancement.

The triangulated analysis, constrained to a single methodological leg, supports a range of $1.06M to $1.44M, with a median of $1.25M. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer comparables at the same stage, which limits the ability to test this range against comparable transaction multiples or investor return expectations. A more granular valuation would require either identification of additional Seed-stage Climate & Energy peers or clarity on Electric Air's differentiated technical or market position relative to the broader comp set.
